<function name="GetDemoFileDetails" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Retrieves data about the demo with the specified filename. Similar to <page>Global.GetSaveFileDetails</page>.</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="filename" type="string">The file name of the demo.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">Demo data.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
